stubs.note: Siemens.Simatic.DistributedIO ReadRecord, which reads a data record from an I/O device. Names are case-insensitive, so the upper-case uses (INDEX, RECORD, BUSY and so on) match. The record buffer comes in several sizes, so it is ARRAY[*] OF BYTE.
